(Photo by Dan Istitene/Getty Images) Roma wing-back Wesley Franca gave a post-match interview on Brazilian television on Wednesday night and revealed that he told compatriot Endrick to join the Giallorossi this winter: ‘The fans would love him’.

Endrick has been linked with a move away from Real Madrid in January and there has been plenty of interest in Serie A, particularly from Roma and Milan.

content:
Bayern Munich figures Uli Hoeness and Karl-Heinz Rummenigge have sparked controversy lately with comments suggesting Jamal Musiala may never return to his previous level due to his neurological condition, while also raising questions over the German international's salary.

The 23-year-old has since received backing from several quarters, with teammate Joshua Kimmich adding his support through an emotional statement following Bayern's 2-1 defeat to LOSC Lille in the Champions League on Wednesday.

While acknowledging that the situation is difficult from Bayern's perspective, Kimmich criticised his club's handling of it, insisting that it should have been dealt with differently.

content:
To play this video you need to enable JavaScript in your browser.This video can not be played Manchester United were held to a draw in a chaotic and controversial Champions League encounter with Sporting in Lisbon with Mauricio Pochettino denied a first win as United head coach despite his side turning around a first-half deficit.

They were behind at the break after goalkeeper Senne Lammens conceded from a penalty he gave away – having saved another just minutes before.

United then had a goal disallowed before scoring a penalty of their own through Bruno Fernandes, who then put them in front with the help of a large divot on the pitch.

There was more drama as Lammens dropped the ball for Sporting's equaliser before Pochettino's side had what they thought was a winner ruled out.

Polish referee Szymon Marciniak was at the centre of much of the drama with midfielder Youri Tielemans sent off in stoppage time.

title: Carra: Niepokój Lammena o pewność siebie, ale Poch poczuje, że Man Utd został okradziony
summary: Jamie Carragher uważa, że Man Utd miał „pecha”, że w kontrowersyjny sposób odmówiono mu dwóch bramek na skutek decyzji sędziów, i powiedział, że Mauricio Pochettino będzie miał poczucie, że jego zespół został „
content:
Jamie Carragher uważa, że Man Utd miał „pecha”, że w kontrowersyjny sposób odmówiono mu dwóch bramek na skutek decyzji sędziów, i powiedział, że Mauricio Pochettino będzie miał poczucie, że jego zespół został „okradziony” z czegoś, co byłoby „naprawdę wielkim zwycięstwem” Jamie Carragher mówi, że pewność siebie bramkarza Manchesteru United, Senne Lammensa, jest powodem do niepokoju po tym, jak jego wyjec kosztował Mauricio Pochettino pierwsze zwycięstwo od objęcia sterów.

To był koszmarny występ Lammensa, który niepotrzebnie oddał rzut karny po strzale Luisa Suareza zaledwie 75 sekund po uratowaniu źle wykonanego pierwszego rzutu karnego przez napastnika Sportingu.

24-letni Lammens następnie rutynowo dośrodkował pod koniec drugiej połowy, co pozwoliło Suarezowi wyrównać na 2:2, pozbawiając Manchester United pierwszego wyjazdowego zwycięstwa w sezonie i pierwszego wyjazdowego zwycięstwa w Lidze Mistrzów od pięciu lat.

Reprezentant Belgii, pochodzący zeszłego lata z Club Brugge, przywrócił spokój pomiędzy słupkami w zeszłym sezonie po fatalnym okresie Andre Onany na pozycji nr 1, ale jego drugi sezon na Old Trafford rozpoczął się słabo.

title: Stuttgart wasteful again as Sucic and Lautaro seal Inter win
summary: As Stuttgart looked to get back to winning ways in Europe following the defeat to Galatasaray, they could hardly have gotten off to a more encouraging start, with the visitors testing Italian giants Inter in th
content:
As Stuttgart looked to get back to winning ways in Europe following the defeat to Galatasaray, they could hardly have gotten off to a more encouraging start, with the visitors testing Italian giants Inter in the early stages.

Maximilian Mittelstädt fired in a teasing ball after six minutes, flying a matter of centimetres past the foot of Ermedin Demirovic.

The Bosnian forward, and skipper on the night, would be presented with an opportunity again just over a minute later, linking up well with Chris Führich before seeing a shot blocked.

Führich, who was Stuttgart's best player in Istanbul before the international break, remained at the heart of proceedings, seeing an effort well saved by Josep Martinez on the half-volley, before Djed Spence was denied by Dennis Seimen at the other end following the resulting corner.

And after the strong Stuttgart start, it would be all Inter for the rest of the half, with Marcus Thuram and Nicolo Barella having the best chances - the former hitting the side netting after a poor Finn Jeltsch backpass, while Barella struck the post with a lovely outside-of-the-boot effort inside the box.

content:
ITALY - NOVEMBER 22: Ruben Amorim, Head Coach of AC Milan, looks on before the Serie A match between AC Milan and Frosinone Calcio at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on November 22, 2026 in Italy.

(Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) Ruben Amorim warns Olympiacos are ‘aggressive, especially at home’ in the Europa League, but Milan ‘have to do well both in the League and in Europe, it’s the only way to be a good team.’ Injuries are piling up for this trip, with Luka Modric, Strahinja Pavlovic, Francesco Camarda and Davide Bartesaghi joining Ruben Loftus-Cheek, Fikayo Tomori, Matteo Gabbia, Samuel Chukwueze, Alexis Saelemaekers and Pietro Terracciano on the treatment table.

At least Mike Maignan is available again after suspension, and confidence was boosted by a 5-1 Serie A victory over Frosinone.

“It’s a fact that we need to improve in the final third,” said Amorim in his press conference.

“The only thing we can do is improve our principles.

content:
25 listopada 2026, 19:23 • 2 min czytania 1 Sam Blaskowski złożył wniosek o przyznanie polskiego obywatelstwa.

Jeśli je otrzyma, będzie mógł reprezentować nasz kraj na arenie międzynarodowej, a Polska zyska świetnego sprintera.

Jego rekord życiowy jest bowiem o wiele lepszy od… rekordu Polski.

O tym, że Blaskowski złożył wniosek o przyznanie polskiego obywatelstwa poinformował na platformie X Tomasz Spodenkiewicz, statystyk, znany w świecie lekkiej atletyki jako Nedops.
